WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 10 AND 12
  AND cs.region = 'South'
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT 'sales' AS t, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rl, MIN(sale_date) AS mn, MAX(sale_date) AS mx, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 10 AND 12
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), MIN(return_date), MAX(return_date), 0
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 10 AND 12
UNION ALL
SELECT 'calendar', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_period), 0, MIN(calendar_date), MAX(calendar_date), 0
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 10 AND 12
SELECT store_id, store_name, region, is_current, valid_from, valid_to FROM dim_store WHERE region IN ('South','Capital Region') OR store_id IN (114) ORDER BY store_id, valid_from

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id < 900
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id < 900
),
mine AS (
  SELECT SUM(n.net_sales) AS v FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=n.store_id AND cs.is_current
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 10 AND 12 AND cs.region='South'
),
ctrl AS (
  SELECT SUM(r.net_sales) AS v FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=r.store_id AND cs.is_current
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 10 AND 12 AND cs.region='South'
),
curdup AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM (SELECT sku FROM dim_product WHERE is_current GROUP BY sku HAVING COUNT(*)>1)),
storedup AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current GROUP BY store_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1))
SELECT mine.v AS mine, ctrl.v AS control, curdup.c AS dup_current_skus, storedup.c AS dup_current_stores FROM mine, ctrl, curdup, storedup

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) DESC) AS rank, cp.sku, cp.product_name, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4 AND cs.region = 'South'
GROUP BY cp.sku, cp.product_name
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 10
